If you've just been laid off, this video is for you.

In this video, I explain the 10-day plan I’ve used as an Ex-Google recruiter and 4x layoff survivor to help you recover quickly after a layoff.

Most people don’t struggle because of the layoff.
They struggle because of the panic that follows.
This plan brings you back into control.

What you’ll learn:
• Days 0-2: Financial triage
• Days 3-5: Defining your narrative
• Days 5-10: Re-activating your network without desperation

If you want structure, clarity, and a plan you can actually follow, you’re in the right place.
